notices.title: GitHub rate limit reached
notices.text: GitHub: your account's rate limit is used up, so PRs wait until it resets. `gh` and your agents draw on the same limit.

notices.title: config.toml has a problem
notices.text: config.toml: TOML parse error at line 14, column 9: invalid string, expected `"`. Codealong is using the last good settings.
